items.headline: FBS oversight committee says it can't overturn WMU's loss
items.description: The NCAA's FBS oversight committee acknowledged that replay protocols were not properly followed at the end of Western Michigan's controversial loss to Michigan in Week 1 but said it does not have the authority to overturn the result of the game.

items.headline: Lowry throws for 3 TDs, Buckley runs for 3, and Western Michigan rebounds with win over Monmouth
items.description: — Broc Lowry threw three touchdown passes, Jaylen Buckley ran for three scores, and Western Michigan defeated FCS-opponent Monmouth 49-14 on Saturday night.

items.headline: Western Michigan: Don't feel sorry for us. Feel sorry for our opponents
items.description: Fans on campus and around the country won't forget, but the Broncos are ready to move forward with malice.

items.headline: NCAA establishes 'standard timing protocol' in wake of Michigan win
items.description: The NCAA is establishing a new standard timing protocol in the wake of the controversial decision to award Michigan an extra second despite the broadcast clock showing zeros.
